text:
anya: Quick sync — I sketched an "impact matrix" to split enterprise compliance work into sprint-sized chunks. Goal: decide Q2 boundaries by EOD Fri. Proposed lanes: MUST (SOC2 evidence export + tenant audit query SLA), HIGH (customer KMS/BYOK handshake + rotation), MED (retention UI controls + regional residency toggles).

mike: +1. Need a technical spike for the KMS handshake. My gut: 2–3w to implement handshake + rotation flow, another 1w for e2e tests. Blocker: HSM/KMS integration creds from infra.

sofia: Security notes — SOC2 evidence export must include signed manifests and append-only audit chain. We need a legal-hold flag that prevents deletion even if retention TTL passes. Also: proof of key provenance if customers request key escrow.

nate: From customer side — FinBank and HealthCo pushed this week. FinBank needs 7yr retention + export in NDJSON with per-event signer. HealthCo needs residency + SOC2 evidence for data access logs. Both said they can pay for early access if we support tenant-level retention overrides.

anya: Good context. Thinking acceptance criteria per lane: 
- MUST: export endpoint that returns immutable audit bundle for a tenant for a date range, includes manifest, sha256 list, and signature. Export time SLA: < 30m for up to 100GB snapshot.
- HIGH: BYOK handshake docs + API, rotation workflow, customer-facing key metadata in console. Must have automated verification step.
- MED: retention UI + API to set per-tenant TTL and region. Soft-delete vs purge semantics documented.

mike: For MUST export SLA, we should add an incremental export mode (delta since last snapshot) to keep compute reasonable. Implementation notes: store manifests in append-only bucket, indexed by tenant+date. I'd schedule the export work across two sprints if accepted.

sofia: Also require audit of access to export endpoint itself (who exported, when, justification). That data must be part of the exported bundle.

nate: Customers want a preview of the export schema. Quick example they asked for: 
```
{ "events": [{ "ts": 1680000000, "actor": "service-a", "action": "model.generate", "resource": "tenant-123", "signature": "..." }],
  "manifest": { "sha256": "...", "signed_by": "redwood-sys" }
}
```

anya: Action items: 
- @mike: spike for KMS handshake + effort estimate (owner). Due Tue EOD.
- @sofia: write security acceptance checklist for export bundles + legal-hold semantics. Due Wed.
- @nate: consolidate FinBank/HealthCo asks into a single feature request doc with monetization notes. Due Wed.
- @anya: finalize impact matrix and recommended sprint boundaries, circulate for leadership sign-off Fri AM.

mike: Noted. Also tagging @eng-infra for HSM creds — need escalations if not provisioned in 48h.

ops-bot: doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/impact-matrix-draft.md (public link restricted) :page_facing_up:

sofia: One more risk: if we expose rotation APIs, we need replay-safe key rotation (old keys must still validate historical manifests). Add that to acceptance.

anya: Good catch. I'll update the matrix. If we all agree on this scope, I'll push the MUST lane into the next sprint and schedule the KMS spike immediately. Quick poll: move MUST into sprint-12?

mike: 👍 move to sprint-12.

nate: 👍 from sales/SE side — FinBank is green to pilot in sprint-13 if we ship an export MVP in sprint-12.

sofia: 👍 security sign-off contingent on checklist completion.

anya: Great — locking in sprint-12 for MUST. I'll post the updated matrix in #product and link the acceptance checklist when Sofia finishes. Thanks all.
